title: Decision Brief
subtitle: Choose at a fork using visible criteria and a clear recommendation.

items.title: Ship now
items.desc: Fastest path, accepts known visual debt.

items.title: Harden first
items.desc: One more pass closes the known failure class.

items.title: Defer
items.desc: Avoids current risk but delays feedback.

components.text: Recommendation: harden first. The known bug class is narrow, testable, and cheaper to close before release.
